subject.title: fix(pdf): PDF analysis fails for plugin-provided and bundled-catalog models

question: After rebasing, should PDF analysis adopt the full shared resolver contract, including provider runtime hooks, bundled static-catalog fallback, and its returned auth storage?
rationale: The shared path is the cleanest fix and has strong evidence, but it broadens PDF provider and credential selection beyond the shipped registry-only behavior, which is an upgrade-sensitive owner decision.

options.title: Adopt shared resolver after rebase
options.body: Resolve the conflicts, preserve this convergence, and require exact-model plugin and agent-scoped OAuth PDF proof before merge.

options.title: Keep a narrower PDF lookup
options.body: Limit PDF to a dedicated catalog-aware lookup, accepting duplicated resolver policy to reduce the provider-runtime behavior change.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared resolver after rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts, preserve this convergence, and require exact-model plugin and agent-scoped OAuth PDF proof before merge.
